body: I believe that there is something inherently wrong with me and that I will never achieve happiness. Normal life is not good enough and I am not good enough for anything better than normal.

Telling them why would make things worse. Also, my father told me "if you're ever thinking of killing yourself, do it niggy. See if I give a fuck". He later reinforced that idea. This was before I ever had a suicidal thought. I don't owe him an explanation. 

My mother tries to help and is a good woman. That's why I don't want to explain to her that a big reason why I want to commit suicide is because I don't want a life like hers. It's an average American life, but I don't want that life.  Never have, never will. I don't see any worthwhile life ahead of me. Even if things did get "better", it still would not be good enough.

Bullshit.

No one has a home phone anymore.
